Why your mind rejects an affirmation it can't believe.

Kevin explains the difference between a dream and your reality today. Many people live in a dream world they can't connect to where they are now, so doubt creeps in.

When they repeat a big affirmation, their mind answers, "You're lying." That sets up what Kevin calls counter intention, which works against you, not for you.

Which of your goals does your mind not believe yet?
